golden_content:
# Semantic Cache Leaf Map - Phase 0.5
# Maps directory structure and artifact types for the semantic cache system

# Engine Separation
engines:
  resume_engine:
    description: "Resume Engine (RG) semantic cache artifacts"
    path: "resume_engine/"
    artifact_types:
      - ast
      - embedding  
      - golden
      - safety
  outreach_engine:
    description: "Outreach Engine (LIC) semantic cache artifacts"
    path: "outreach_engine/"
    artifact_types:
      - ast
      - embedding
      - golden
      - safety

# Version Folder Structure
version_structure:
  pattern: "{version_name}/"
  examples:
    - "v2/"
    - "v6.0/"
    - "v7.0/"
    - "v8.0/"
    - "v9.0/"
    - "v10.7/"
    - "Agentic-Workflow-10_11/"
    - "Microservices Model/"

# Artifact Types
artifacts:
  ast:
    extension: ".ast"
    description: "Abstract Syntax Tree representation"
    metadata: ".ast.meta.json"
  embedding:
    extension: ".embedding"
    description: "64-dimensional embedding vectors"
